qualifier: cranial ganglia and olfactory placode derivatives (olfactory nerve, GnRH neuron migration)
name: Brainstem and cranial nerve development, including olfactory placode derivatives
rationale: All members concern development of the brainstem/hindbrain and the cranial nerves and ganglia they serve; cranial ganglion, olfactory nerve, GnRH neuron migration and taste papilla members distinguish it from the spinal-cord, enteric and dorsal-root-ganglion confusables.

qualifier: endocrine control by PTH and FGF23/Klotho
name: Vitamin D, PTH and FGF23 control of bone mineralization
rationale: Members cover vitamin D synthesis/catabolism and its disorders, PTH and FGF23-Klotho signalling, phosphate response and regulation of bone mineralization, distinguishing it from confusables centred on sodium-phosphate transporters, tooth mineralization or vitamin K.

qualifier: selenium compound methylation and excretion
name: Folate-methionine one-carbon cycle and selenium methylation
rationale: Members are folate/tetrahydrofolate, methionine/SAM metabolism and their inborn errors plus neural tube closure, and the ingested-selenium methylation pathways distinguish it from confusables on transsulfuration, other B vitamins and cobalamin.

qualifier: trophoblast differentiation and early pregnancy
name: Eye morphogenesis and placental trophoblast development
rationale: Members split between camera-type eye development (lens, retina vasculature, cornea, iris, eyelid) and placenta/early pregnancy (trophoblast, labyrinth, decidualization); the trophoblast-placental block distinguishes it from the eye-only confusables.

qualifier: host promoter clearance, preinitiation assembly and pausing, not HIV transcription
name: Regulation of RNA polymerase II promoter escape and pausing
rationale: All members concern Pol II promoter clearance, preinitiation complex assembly, pausing and early elongation; positive regulation of preinitiation assembly and transcription-factor control distinguish it from the HIV/Tat-centred and negative-elongation confusables.

core: Rab/ARF GTPase regulation of vesicle traffic
qualifier: Rab prenylation, GEF/GAP cycle and vesicle tethering to Golgi
name: Rab/ARF GTPase regulation and Golgi vesicle tethering
rationale: Members cover Rab GEFs, GAPs, geranylgeranylation and ARF signalling plus vesicle targeting/tethering to the Golgi, distinguishing it from confusables on COPI/COPII coats, Golgi organisation and SNARE docking.

qualifier: cochlear hair-cell stereocilia and brush-border microvilli
name: Stereocilia and brush-border microvillus actin bundle assembly
rationale: All members concern parallel actin-bundled protrusions, either auditory hair-cell stereocilia and mechanotransduction or brush-border microvilli, distinguishing it from inner-ear morphogenesis, vestibular and eye confusables.

qualifier: dolichol-linked precursor and GDP-mannose synthesis, congenital disorders of glycosylation
name: Dolichol-pathway N-glycosylation and congenital disorders of glycosylation
rationale: Members are dolichol-phosphate, GDP-mannose and lipid-linked oligosaccharide synthesis, N-glycan processing and their CDG defects, distinguishing it from confusables on nucleotide-sugar transport, UDP-GlcNAc synthesis and GPI anchors.

qualifier: PIEZO1 sensing of fluid shear, pressure and cell volume
name: PIEZO1 mechanosensing of fluid shear, pressure and cell volume
rationale: Members are PIEZO1-mediated responses to laminar and oscillatory shear and mechanical load plus hydrostatic pressure, cell volume, blebbing and membrane repair, distinguishing it from eNOS, vascular permeability and SRF confusables.

qualifier: salvage route to deoxyribonucleotides and dTTP
name: Pyrimidine salvage and deoxyribonucleotide (dTTP) biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern pyrimidine nucleoside salvage and deoxyribonucleotide/dTTP synthesis, distinguishing it from de novo UMP/UTP synthesis and deoxynucleotide catabolism confusables.

qualifier: glyoxylate metabolism and glycine conjugation of xenobiotic acids
name: Glycine-threonine-alanine metabolism and glycine conjugation of xenobiotic acids
rationale: Members cover threonine catabolism, glycine/glyoxylate and alanine metabolism and mitochondrial glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, distinguishing it from sulfur, aromatic, proline and glutamate amino acid confusables.

qualifier: AP-site gap-filling steps and mitochondrial DNA repair
name: Base excision repair gap filling and mitochondrial DNA repair
rationale: Members are AP-site processing and short/long-patch BER gap filling plus mitochondrial DNA repair and metabolism, distinguishing it from broad double-strand-break, glycosylase, mismatch and chromatin confusables.

qualifier: magnesium handling and paracellular tight-junction transport
name: Renal sodium/potassium transport and paracellular magnesium handling
rationale: Members cover renal sodium and potassium transport regulation plus magnesium homeostasis and claudin-type paracellular tight-junction transport, distinguishing it from Na/K-ATPase, SLC12 cotransporter and osmotic-response confusables.

qualifier: common gamma-chain, IL-12 and IL-10 family cytokines, NK cells
name: Gamma-chain, IL-12 and IL-10 family interleukin JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: Members are signalling by IL-2/7/9/15/21, IL-3/5, IL-12/23/27/35 and IL-10/20 family interleukins with NK-cell regulation and STAT control, the IL-12 and IL-10 families distinguishing it from IL-6/gp130 and T-cell confusables.

qualifier: cellular redox homeostasis
name: Reactive oxygen species detoxification and cellular redox homeostasis
rationale: All three members concern ROS detoxification and redox homeostasis, distinguishing it from ascorbate, selenium, reactive nitrogen and metal-response confusables.

qualifier: myoblast/satellite-cell myogenesis, hypertrophy-atrophy adaptation and regeneration
name: Striated muscle myogenesis, growth adaptation and regeneration
rationale: Members regulate myoblast proliferation/fusion, satellite cells, skeletal and cardiac muscle cell growth, adaptation and regeneration, distinguishing it from calcineurin fiber-type, sarcomere contraction and extraocular muscle confusables.

qualifier: mesenchymal branching growth, trachea and pneumocyte differentiation
name: Lung and airway morphogenesis and pneumocyte differentiation
rationale: Members cover lung branching, mesenchyme, lobe/saccule, trachea, pneumocyte and secretory cell differentiation (with diaphragm, palate and ductus closure), distinguishing it from salivary branching, surfactant and pancreas/kidney confusables.

qualifier: DSCAM, Sidekick, nectin and RPTP interactions, dendrite self-avoidance
name: DSCAM/Sidekick/nectin neuronal adhesion and dendrite self-avoidance
rationale: Members concern immunoglobulin-superfamily neuronal adhesion (DSCAM, SDK, nectins, receptor PTPs) and dendrite self-avoidance, distinguishing it from L1-family/axon-initial-segment and retinal confusables.

qualifier: regulation of synthesis and arachidonate/prostaglandin release
name: Regulation of prostaglandin synthesis and arachidonate release
rationale: All members regulate prostaglandin biosynthesis or secretion and arachidonate release, distinguishing it from prostanoid receptor and COX enzymatic-reaction confusables.

qualifier: nucleoside-analog drug and xenobiotic transport
name: Nucleoside, nucleobase and xenobiotic drug membrane transport
rationale: Members are purine/pyrimidine nucleoside and nucleobase transport (ENT/SLC29), nucleoside-analog drug handling and xenobiotic efflux, distinguishing it from nucleotide interconversion and catabolism confusables.

qualifier: proton-coupled di/tripeptide and histidine transport
name: Proton-coupled oligopeptide and histidine transmembrane transport
rationale: Members concern proton/oligopeptide cotransporters moving di/oligopeptides and histidine across plasma and vacuolar membranes, distinguishing it from neutral and cationic amino acid transporter and histamine confusables.

qualifier: p53 and DREAM/E2F transcriptional repression of cell-cycle genes
name: G2/M progression and its p53/DREAM transcriptional repression
rationale: Members cover G2 phase, cyclin B-CDK1, PLK and MASTL control of mitotic entry and p53/DREAM/p107-p130 repression of cell-cycle genes, distinguishing it from APC/C mitotic exit, DNA-damage, G1/S and E2F-activation confusables.

qualifier: miRNA transcription, processing and turnover, and miRNA control of specific targets
name: Regulation of miRNA processing, turnover and target-specific translation
rationale: Members regulate miRNA transcription, pri/pre-miRNA processing and target-directed degradation plus miRNA control of named targets, distinguishing it from core miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, RISC and mRNA-decay confusables.

qualifier: TKI-resistant mutants and fusions, with EPO/STAT5 signalling
name: Oncogenic RTK mutants, TKI resistance and EPO/STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members are constitutively active and inhibitor-resistant KIT, PDGFR, FLT3, ALK, ERBB2, EGFR and FGFR mutants and fusions plus EPO/TPO/IL-3 STAT5 signalling, distinguishing it from MET/PI3K, wild-type RTK-RAS and interleukin JAK-STAT confusables.

core: Golgi glycosylation of secreted and matrix proteins
qualifier: proteoglycan GAG chains and Notch/TSR O-fucose/O-glucose
name: Proteoglycan glycosaminoglycan synthesis and Notch O-fucosylation/O-glucosylation
rationale: Members cover chondroitin, dermatan, heparan and keratan sulfate chain synthesis and linkage region with their disorders, plus O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of Notch and TSR proteins, distinguishing it from dystroglycan O-mannose, sulfate-transport and N-glycan confusables.
